荷兰移民与归化局（IND, Immigratie- en Naturalisat: Immigration and Naturalisation Service of the Netherlands (IND, Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst)
在荷兰读完本科、硕士、博士或做完研究后，可申请一年的求职居留（zoekjaar）: After finishing a bachelor's, master's, doctorate or research project in the Netherlands you can apply for a one-year job-search permit (zoekjaar). Work is completely unrestricted during that year and the employer needs no work permit. Graduates of foreign institutions can also apply, but the institution must rank in the top 200 of at least two of THE, QS and ShanghaiRanking, and the degree must be evaluated by Nuffic. The permit cannot be extended; finding a job within the year means switching to a highly skilled migrant or self-employed permit.
IND 页面按「你在哪读书、什么时候毕业」判断，不按国籍排除。中国大陆护照持有人: The IND page decides by where you studied and when you graduated, not by nationality. Mainland Chinese passport holders qualify on both routes: a degree earned in the Netherlands, or a degree from a foreign institution that clears the ranking threshold. Turkish citizens and their family members fall under a separate set of rules explained on the same official page.
官方页面未设年龄限制。0-99 表示「无年龄要求」，不是「未核实」。真正的门槛是: The official page sets no age limit. A range of 0-99 means no age requirement, not unverified. The real threshold is timing: the programme or research must have been completed within 3 years before the application date.
满足以下任一情形即可：①在荷兰高等教育机构完成经认证的本科或硕士项目；②在荷兰完: Any one of the following is enough: (1) an accredited bachelor's or master's programme at a Dutch higher education institution; (2) a post-master's programme of at least one academic year (at least 10 months) in the Netherlands; (3) a study programme in the Netherlands under the Cultural Policy (Special-Purpose Funding) Act; (4) a study programme in the Netherlands under the development cooperation policy of the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs; (5) a master's, doctoral or post-master's programme at a designated foreign institution; (6) scientific research in the Netherlands within 3 years before the application, under a research permit pursuant to Directive (EU) 2016/801 or a research-based highly skilled migrant permit whose contract carries a UFO job code starting with 01; (7) a master's degree from an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master programme obtained within 3 years before the application.
只有「境外院校毕业」这条路要查语言，且在荷兰毕业的人不适用。境外院校毕业生须满足: Language only matters on the foreign-institution route and never applies to people who graduated in the Netherlands. Foreign graduates must meet one of the following: IELTS overall 6.0 (Academic or General Training, since the official text says `It does not matter which version you have`); a score equivalent to 6.0 on another test listed in the Language tests appendix to the Code of Conduct; a diploma as referred to in Article 4, first paragraph, part b of the Civic Integration Act 2021; a diploma as referred to in Article 2.3, first paragraph of the Civic Integration Decree; or a master's, doctoral or post-master's programme taught in English or Dutch. The official page states no score validity period, so `validity_months: 24` is an inference rather than an official figure; confirm with the IND before applying.
官方 orientation year 页面未列资金门槛，核心条件是学历与院校排: The official orientation year page lists no funds threshold; the deciding factors are the degree and the institution's ranking, not a bank balance. If you enter from abroad on an MVV (provisional residence permit), the MVV has its own general requirements, per the IND page. This differs from Germany's Section 20, where the statute expressly requires proof of subsistence; the Dutch route has no such requirement.
入境后须做结核病（TB）筛查，在拿到居留许可后 3 个月内到市政卫生服务局（GG: A tuberculosis (TB) screening is required after arrival: book it with the municipal health service (GGD) within 3 months of receiving the permit. Exemptions: nationality listed in the exemption appendix; already holding a valid Dutch permit and only changing purpose of stay; born in the Netherlands and always lived there; 11 years old or younger; a TB test in the Netherlands less than 6 months ago; holding an EU long-term resident permit or being a family member of one.
12 岁以上申请人必须完整填写《Antecedents Certificate》: Applicants over 12 must fully complete the Antecedents Certificate and enclose it with the application. It is a declaration about whether you have ever been convicted, not a request to obtain a separate police clearance certificate.
在荷兰境内可在线申请（需 DigiD、BSN、BRP 登记、且毕业后仍持有效居留: From inside the Netherlands you can apply online, which requires DigiD, a BSN, BRP registration and a still-valid permit for the study purpose. From abroad you apply for the MVV and the residence permit together at a Dutch embassy or consulate. People who have left and whose permit expired less than 2 years ago are still covered.
不得为同一段科研、同一个学习项目或博士项目重复申请过 orientation y: You may not hold an orientation year permit twice for the same research, the same study programme or the same doctoral programme. A second permit is possible after a different research project or a different programme completed later; the official page devotes a separate section to second and subsequent orientation years.
不设名额上限，也没有统一开放窗口。约束是「毕业/完成研究之日起 3 年内」这个个: There is no cap and no common opening window. The only constraint is the personal 3-year window counted from graduation or completion of research, so apply as early as possible.
全年滚动受理。申请日起往前推 3 年内完成学业或研究者均可申请。: Rolling intake all year. Anyone who completed the programme or research within 3 years before the application date can apply.
同上。费用与条件按 IND 页面当期版本执行，最近一次更新为 2026-10-0: Same as above. Fees and conditions follow the version of the IND page in force at the time; the most recent update was 7 October 2026.
居留许可申请费（首次申请或转换居留目的）: Residence permit application fee (first application or change of purpose of stay)
官方写明 IND 必须在 90 天内作出决定（`The IND must tak: The IND must decide within 90 days, as stated in `The IND must take a decision within 90 days.` The decision period can be extended when documents are incomplete, and the IND sends a separate letter in that case.
走 MVV 时，护照在贴签证时的剩余有效期须不少于 6 个月；MVV 本身有效期: On the MVV route the passport must remain valid for at least 6 more months when the visa sticker is placed; the MVV itself is valid for 90 days.
荷兰院校的学位或「完成学业声明」；境外院校的学位须先经 Nuffic 认证（比利: A degree or statement of completion from a Dutch institution; degrees from foreign institutions must first be evaluated by Nuffic, except for accredited Flemish institutions, whose programme must be registered in the Higher Education Register Flanders.
仅境外院校毕业生需要。认证用于确认外国学历在荷兰的等值程度，Nuffic 也可能: Required only for graduates of foreign institutions. The evaluation establishes what the foreign degree is worth in the Netherlands, and Nuffic may also check whether the diploma is genuine. Graduates of Dutch institutions do not need it.
仅境外院校毕业生需要。院校须在 THE、QS、软科三个发布方中至少两个的前 20: Required only for graduates of foreign institutions. The institution must be in the top 200 of at least two of the three publishers THE, QS and ShanghaiRanking, in either the general ranking or a subject ranking, and the ranking must hold on the date you graduated or were awarded the degree. A subject ranking only counts if the subject matches your field of study or research. General and subject rankings from different publishers may be combined.
仅境外院校毕业生需要，且仅当所读项目不是英语或荷兰语授课时。雅思 6.0（学术类: Required only for graduates of foreign institutions, and only when the programme was not taught in English or Dutch. IELTS 6.0 in either Academic or General Training, or an equivalent score on another test in the Code of Conduct appendix.
12 岁以上申请人必填，随申请一并提交。如实申报是否曾被判罪，不是要求另行开具证: Mandatory for applicants over 12 and enclosed with the application. It is an honest declaration of any convictions, not a separate certificate to be obtained.
到使领馆面交时携带；同时在现场采集指纹与签名作为生物信息。: Bring it to the appointment at the embassy or consulate; fingerprints and a signature are also captured there as biometric data.
官方文件的公证与翻译: Legalisation and translation of official documents
境外官方文件须做公证（legalised）并译成荷兰语、英语、法语或德语之一。: Official foreign documents must be legalised and translated into Dutch, English, French or German.
确认自己落在哪一条资格路径: Confirm which eligibility route you are on
先分清是「荷兰院校毕业」还是「境外院校毕业」。前者只看学位与毕业时间；后者还多两: First decide whether you graduated from a Dutch institution or a foreign one. The Dutch route looks only at the degree and the graduation date; the foreign route adds two gates, the ranking threshold (top 200 in two of three publishers) and Nuffic evaluation, plus an English score when the programme was not taught in English or Dutch. Getting this wrong makes every later step pointless.
申请日往前推 3 年内必须完成学业、取得学位或结束科研。已离境且原居留过期不超过: The programme, degree or research must have been completed within 3 years before the application date. People who have left the country whose permit expired less than 2 years ago are still covered, so returning home does not automatically end eligibility.
备齐材料（境外学历先做 Nuffic 认证）: Gather the documents, starting Nuffic evaluation early on the foreign route
境外学历的 Nuffic 认证耗时最长，先启动。官方申请表格里列了完整清单，表格: Nuffic evaluation takes the longest on the foreign route, so start it first. The official application form lists the full document set and is available in English only. All official foreign documents must be legalised and translated into Dutch, English, French or German.
在荷兰境内且满足五项条件（住在荷兰、在荷兰毕业/取得博士/做研究、持对应有效居留: From inside the Netherlands you can apply online when five conditions hold: you live there, you graduated, took a doctorate or did research there, you hold a valid permit for that purpose, you are registered in the BRP and you have a BSN. Online applications need DigiD and are paid with iDEAL. From abroad, book an appointment at a Dutch embassy or consulate and file the MVV and residence permit applications together; wait 1 week after the appointment before sending documents, and no later than 3 weeks after it.
在线申请时用 iDEAL 立即支付；书面申请会收到缴费信。境外通道同样在面谈后: Online applications are paid immediately with iDEAL; paper applications receive a payment letter. On the foreign route, pay 1 week after the appointment and no later than 3 weeks after it.
等决定（最长 90 天）: Wait for the decision (up to 90 days)
IND 须在 90 天内作出决定，可通过 My IND 跟踪进度。材料不齐时决定: The IND must decide within 90 days and progress can be tracked in My IND. The decision period is extended when documents are incomplete, with a separate letter explaining why. Decision letters usually arrive through Zivver.
贴 MVV 或领居留卡: Collect the MVV sticker or the residence card
境外获批后须在决定作出后 3 个月内到原递交的使领馆贴 MVV 签证贴纸，随后入: After approval from abroad, have the MVV sticker placed at the same embassy or consulate within 3 months of the decision, then travel. If approved inside the Netherlands, wait for the letter from the IND desk and book an appointment to collect the card.
入境后做 TB 筛查并处理后续身份: Take the TB test after arrival and plan the next status
在拿到居留许可后 3 个月内到 GGD 做结核病筛查（符合豁免情形者除外）。一年: Book the TB screening with the GGD within 3 months of receiving the permit, unless an exemption applies. A job found within the year requires switching to a highly skilled migrant, self-employed or start-up permit, since the orientation year itself cannot be extended.
明文不可延长：`You cannot extend the residence: Explicitly non-extendable: `You cannot extend the residence permit for the orientation year for highly educated persons.` A job found within the year means switching to another purpose of stay such as highly skilled migrant, self-employed or start-up. The exception is a second orientation year, available after a different research project or a different Dutch study or doctoral programme completed after the previous orientation year.
工作完全自由：`You may work freely in the Nethe: Work is entirely unrestricted: `You may work freely in the Netherlands or do an internship. Your employer does not need a work permit`, and you may also work as an independent entrepreneur, self-employed person or freelancer. The back of the card reads `Work freely permitted, TWV not required`. Working while the application is pending is allowed, but only after a Residence Endorsement sticker is placed in the passport (`Arbeid vrij toegestaan, TWV niet vereist`), and only when the application included a copy of a Dutch diploma, a Nuffic-evaluated foreign diploma, or proof of research in the past 3 years.
境外院校这条路最容易踩的坑是排名口径：院校必须在 THE、QS、软科三个发布方中: The trap on the foreign route is how the ranking rule reads: the institution must sit in the top 200 of at least two of THE, QS and ShanghaiRanking, measured on your graduation date rather than the application date. A single top-200 listing, or a subject ranking unrelated to your field, does not qualify.
3 年时间窗从毕业或结束研究之日起算，不是从拿到居留卡起算，也不是从回国起算。拖: The 3-year window runs from graduation or the end of research, not from the date the card is issued and not from the date you return home. Missing it closes this route permanently.
境外学历必须先经 Nuffic 认证，这一步常被忽略且耗时最长（按 1-2 个月: Foreign degrees must be evaluated by Nuffic first. This step is often overlooked and takes the longest, so budget 1-2 months. Flemish institutions are exempt from evaluation but the programme must be registered in the Higher Education Register Flanders.
英语成绩只在「境外院校毕业 + 项目非英语/荷兰语授课」时被要求。官方页面没写成: An English score is required only for foreign graduates whose programme was not taught in English or Dutch. The official page states no validity period, so the 24 months shown here is an inference and should be confirmed with the IND before applying.
这一年不计入永久居留所需的居住年限，也不是工作许可的替代品——它只是给你时间找工: The year does not count towards the residence years required for permanent residence and is not a substitute for a work permit; it only buys time to find work. If no work-related permit is obtained by the end of the year, you have to leave.
12 岁以上都要填《Antecedents Certificate》，这是申报表: Everyone over 12 completes the Antecedents Certificate, which is a declaration form rather than a certificate. Fill it in honestly; treating it as a police clearance to be legalised wastes time.
